## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance

## Testing

- [ ] Loaded unpacked extension in Chrome
- [ ] Reloaded extension from `chrome://extensions/`
- [ ] Refreshed target webpage
- [ ] Tested text selection and inline bubble
- [ ] Tested provider request, or explained why it was not tested

## Checklist

- [ ] No API keys, tokens, logs, or private screenshots committed
- [ ] README/docs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Permissions are still justified in README
